scope: Read-only supplied native clips evaluated through the actual factory, full normal tunic, low shoes, wooden spear and wooden shield before new combat layers

attack.sourceMotion: Two-arm overhead swing. Adult right-hand height rises from 0.740m to 1.570m, then the hand extends forward and drops.
attack.decision: Reuse the existing full Attack source for unarmed strike. A spear action reuses its bounded initial torso/leg wind-up with an original-rig arm/hand correction because the measured grip plus unmodified source arms points the real spear backward during the swing. No new source animation was requested.

death.decision: Reuse the existing source death, clamp the sample endpoint, and constrain horizontal hip translation to the native anchor while retaining its vertical fall and rotations.

limitations: Numeric rig/garment evidence, not whole-garment penetration certification, GPU/device performance or owner visual approval. The source assessment preceded the new native presentation layers.
